lines.text: Many learners say: I bought a pasta for her birthday.
Better: I bought a cake for her birthday.
Pasta is not a cake. Say cake.
Cake! Here is a birthday cake.

data.wrong: I bought a pasta for her birthday.
data.right: I bought a cake for her birthday.

en.tip: For a sweet birthday food, say “cake”; pasta is food like spaghetti: “I bought a cake for her birthday.”
en.caption: Do you say “I bought a pasta for her birthday”? 😅 In English a birthday sweet is a cake, because pasta is food like spaghetti. The right sentence is “I bought a cake for her birthday.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
